title: Lines of Hope
provenance: Original RTS AI narrative: an alternate-history sequel to the original Red Alert (1996). Einstein, the Chronosphere, the Iron Curtain and Tanya appear by the owner's decision of 14 October 2026 under EA's free, non-commercial modding guidelines. Every line of dialogue is new; no original cinematics, dialogue or recordings are used. The six 2026 scenarios and project map previews are reused as built.

prologue.intro: Nineteen fifty-three. The Red Alert war is over, and Albert Einstein has one task left: switch off the machine that started it. But Arkady Orlov, the man missing from every photograph of Stalin's court, reaches the Chronosphere first, and the Allied commando Tanya reaches him. The machine falls silent. Its echo does not.

epilogue.intro: Every light is back on, and every coil cache on the manifest is accounted for. Lantern goes back to her wall and pins the last print to it: the photograph of the Chronosphere's first test in 1946, Einstein beside the machine. She knows every face in it. Tonight there is one more.

sequel.title: The Retoucher
sequel.premise: Orlov spent his life taking himself out of pictures; now he is putting himself back in. The caches were the map of every place the echo touched, and he has followed it back to the first jump, the 1946 test that made the Red Alert century. If he can stand in that photograph, he can stand at the switch. On the coasts of 2026 his last loyalists fight on battlefields that edit themselves behind them, and the commanders who kept the lines open must hold one line more: the timeline itself.

arcs.title: The Lifeline
arcs.premise: 2026. On one coast in crisis the radar goes quiet and the picture starts to lie. Keep aid moving, restore the coastal picture, and see the ships through.

arcs.title: Broken Signals
arcs.premise: Someone sells every side its picture and cuts it when it pays. Two operations against the Obsidian Directorate's hardware, and one exercise built from what they teach.

arcs.title: The Missing Man
arcs.premise: The echo has a source, and the source has a name. Find the man missing from every photograph before he edits the region into a war.

arcs.title: Aftershocks
arcs.premise: The echo is folded shut, but Orlov is gone, and the Directorate's last cells are racing for the coil caches that could open it again. Two coasts, two days; only Lantern's desk connects them.

jizan-corridor.title: A Road Through the Silence
jizan-corridor.speaker: badr
jizan-corridor.intro: At dawn, the coastal radar falls silent. Beyond its range, relief trucks wait on a road nobody can promise is safe. Your task is to restore the picture, remove the mobile launchers, and open a route to the port. A destroyed enemy base is not the measure of success. The convoy must arrive.
jizan-corridor.tactics: Scout the radar approach before committing engineers. Build replacement forces while you clear the launchers; the convoy moves only after both threats are resolved.
jizan-corridor.victory: The radar is back online and the relief trucks have reached the port. One thing does not fit: Radar Node Seven was never destroyed. For six hours it showed an empty sea, and its clock read 1953.
jizan-corridor.defeat: The corridor has closed before the relief operation could finish. Regroup, protect the forward base, and clear the launchers before committing the convoy.

hodeidah-lifeline.title: The Return Journey
hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: nabil
hodeidah-lifeline.intro: The supplies have reached the coast. Now they must reach the people inland. You take command from the other side of the corridor, where a surveillance sweep is approaching and an evacuation convoy still needs a way home. Disperse your mobile force, protect the deliveries, and keep the return route open.
hodeidah-lifeline.tactics: Move mobile forces out of the surveillance zone early. Keep a reserve along the return route instead of sending every unit with the first convoy.
hodeidah-lifeline.victory: Supplies have moved inland and the evacuation convoy has returned. One more thing: the sweep moved four minutes before anything was airborne. Someone was reading the picture before it happened.
hodeidah-lifeline.defeat: The relief route could not be held. On the next attempt, disperse before the sweep and reserve an escort for the evacuation convoy.

bab-al-mandab-passage.title: Four Ships at First Light
bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: turki
bab-al-mandab-passage.intro: Four merchant vessels approach the strait. Their crews see the shipping lanes; your command sees gaps in the coastal picture. Build the radar and technology network, survey the sectors, and remove the mobile threats. Hold Passage Control until the last vessel is through. The lifeline ends where the open sea begins.
bab-al-mandab-passage.tactics: Build the required technology while scouting the sectors. Cover separate shipping lanes and keep defenders at Passage Control during the final escalation.
bab-al-mandab-passage.victory: The merchant group has cleared the passage. Lantern's report is short: every gap in the coastal picture traces back to one maintenance contract, held by the Obsidian Directorate. Its oldest file is a photograph from 1953 with one man cut out.
bab-al-mandab-passage.defeat: The passage remains unsafe. Rebuild the coastal picture, protect each shipping lane, and leave enough forces to hold Passage Control.

straits-shield.title: Across the Divide
straits-shield.speaker: kemal
straits-shield.intro: Orion Group controls the far shore. A straight assault will leave your force stranded between land and sea. Build the branches of your command together: reconnaissance above, mechanized forces ashore, and naval cover along the crossing. The first operation is a lesson in making the whole army matter.
straits-shield.tactics: Develop repair and naval support alongside your land force. Use reconnaissance to choose the crossing before committing the amphibious assault.
straits-shield.victory: The crossing is secured and your forces worked as one command. Inside each uplink the engineers found the same part: a hand-wound coil, older than anyone on the team, dated 1953.
straits-shield.defeat: The crossing has broken your force apart. Establish repair and sea control before committing to the far shore.

haitan-network.title: Bring the Islands Online
haitan-network.speaker: lin
haitan-network.intro: The command network is fragmented across the islands. Obsidian Directorate forces hold the approaches, and the water gate is the only practical route for your amphibious vehicles. Restore the network, secure the crossing, and combine reconnaissance, missiles, aircraft, and ships. Every restored link makes the next move possible.
haitan-network.tactics: Restore the command objectives before the main push. Send amphibious units through the water gate with reconnaissance and supporting fire.
haitan-network.victory: The network is restored and the islands are connected. The links show where the region's traffic was going: to one island no chart names, sending a time code seventy-three years old.
haitan-network.defeat: The network is still fragmented. Secure the water gate and rebuild supporting forces before sending another isolated group forward.

hezbollah-relay.title: Keep the Signal Alive
hezbollah-relay.speaker: signals-chief
hezbollah-relay.intro: A field relay is all that connects your forward teams to their supply base. In this fictional exercise, attacks will arrive before the workshop is secure. Expand the economy, assemble a mixed defense, and keep the signal alive. Only then can you turn the defense into an assault on the opposing command post.
hezbollah-relay.tactics: Build income and the field workshop before the main assault. Mix anti-tank specialists with reconnaissance and keep a defensive reserve at the supply base.
hezbollah-relay.victory: The relay held, the supply base survived, and the opposing command post is down. Exercise complete: a network is only useful when the force behind it can endure.
hezbollah-relay.defeat: The relay operation has failed. Spend first on a sustainable economy and layered defense, then launch the counterattack.

lights-in-the-water.title: Lights in the Water
lights-in-the-water.speaker: nabil
lights-in-the-water.intro: Spoofed navigation signals have walked a fishing fleet onto the reef, and Orion Group patrols are already searching the water. They are looking for someone. Take a small force with no base, find the three stranded crews, and bring every survivor to the town clinic.
lights-in-the-water.tactics: Move in pairs and keep out of the patrols' way until each crew is found. The transports can only reach the reef at high tide: hold the town until then, then bring everyone to the clinic.
lights-in-the-water.victory: Every crew is at the clinic. Among them is a stranger pulled from the sea in a soaked 1950s uniform, who asks what year it is and then gives a name: Tanya.
lights-in-the-water.defeat: The reef is lost. Regroup, find the crews before the patrols do, and keep the clinic standing.

hold-the-ferry-line.title: Hold the Ferry Line
hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.intro: Orion Group wants the strait back, and a whole town is waiting on the quay. Hold three approaches while the ferries load and cross. Twelve minutes. Every ferry.
hold-the-ferry-line.tactics: Cover all three roads with layered defence and keep a mobile reserve. Repair between waves; the piers must stand until the last ferry sails.
hold-the-ferry-line.victory: The line held and every ferry crossed. A captured contractor carried a tasking order with one call sign: Glass Island. And Tanya knows the voice that tried to buy the strait. It belongs to Arkady Orlov.
hold-the-ferry-line.defeat: The approaches collapsed before the ferries could sail. Spread the defence across all three roads and keep a reserve.

glass-island.title: Glass Island
glass-island.speaker: lin
glass-island.intro: The island no chart names is real, and its masts see everything. A three-unit team with Tanya lands at night, stays out of every sensor's sight, copies the routing logs, and leaves by boat.
glass-island.tactics: Watch the sensor masts' sweep before you move. Nothing on this island should ever see you, and the boat leaves at first light.
glass-island.victory: Beside the logs in the Directorate's vault lay a film reel labelled in Einstein's hand. His message from 1953 explains the echo, and how to end it.
glass-island.defeat: The island saw you. Wait for the sweep, move between the masts, and get the team out alive.

black-platform.title: Black Platform
black-platform.speaker: turki
black-platform.intro: While the platform jams, no one can see the hub, and its generators run on an Iron Curtain prototype. Board it with Tanya and a small team, take the control room to drop the curtain, place charges on every generator, and hold the room until the picture comes back.
black-platform.tactics: There are no reinforcements, and only an engineer can take the control room. Clear each deck before you plant a charge, and finish before Orion's relief arrives.
black-platform.victory: Every screen on the coast lights up at once. The hub is exposed, and the Broker makes his offer to everyone at the same time. Nobody answers.
black-platform.defeat: The boarding team is lost and the jamming holds. Clear each deck before moving on.

every-light-on.title: Every Light On
every-light-on.speaker: badr
every-light-on.intro: The Directorate hub stands on a fortified island chain, with the rebuilt Chronosphere at its heart. Cut its radar domes to sever the link, wait for the civilians to be clear, then capture the machine before Orlov uses it to edit the region into war.
every-light-on.tactics: Take the radar domes before you go for the core. The final strike waits for the all-clear from the mainland towns.
every-light-on.victory: The Chronosphere is captured, and as it falls Orlov steps into it and is gone. Lantern runs Einstein's sequence once, the right way, and the echo folds shut. Every light comes back on.
every-light-on.defeat: The hub held. Sever the radar link first, and protect the relay that keeps the picture alive.

sweet-water.title: Sweet Water
sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.intro: Days after every light came back on, the Directorate's last cells are racing for the coil caches that could open the echo again. On a salt coast, one cell has seized a port town's desalination plant, where a cache is hidden, and cut the water. Clear the salt road before the army water trucks are due, bring them in, retake the plant, and take the cache whole.
sweet-water.tactics: Only engineers can take the plant and its vault; nothing on it can be destroyed. Clear each roadblock's gun before the trucks are due, take the power station to shut down the cell's coils, and keep a guard at the road camp for the raids from the north.
sweet-water.victory: The trucks reached the cistern, the pumps are running, and the vault under the plant held a crate of hand-wound coils dated 1953. Its manifest lists one more cache, on another coast.
sweet-water.defeat: The salt road is still closed and the town is dry. Clear the roadblocks before the trucks are due, and send engineers for the plant.

ghosts-on-the-glass.title: Ghosts on the Glass
ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.intro: Two days later, on another coast, a harbour city's picture fills with nine contacts closing on it. Most of them are not there: a Directorate cell is painting phantoms onto every screen to provoke a strike on nothing. Verify every contact before anything fires on it, destroy the relay towers that paint the lie, and keep the shelters standing while the families wait below.
ghosts-on-the-glass.tactics: Send forward observers first and set approaching units to Return fire, so nothing shoots first. A verified phantom fades and its ring turns pale; a real contact's ring turns red.
ghosts-on-the-glass.victory: The relays are down, the phantoms are gone, and the city never fired on nothing. The last relay held the last coil cache on the manifest. Every cache is accounted for. Orlov is not.
ghosts-on-the-glass.defeat: The city fired on a picture, a shelter fell, or the harbour was lost. Verify every contact before anything fires on it.

jizan-corridor.speaker: badr
jizan-corridor.line: Engineers forward. We take the radar back first, then we deal with the launchers.

jizan-corridor.speaker: lantern
jizan-corridor.line: Colonel, this is Lantern at the coordination desk. Your radar isn't dark. It's showing an empty sea, and the clock on it is wrong.

jizan-corridor.speaker: badr
jizan-corridor.line: Radar Node Seven is ours. Now find me those launchers.

jizan-corridor.speaker: badr
jizan-corridor.line: Both launchers are down. Bring the convoy through.

jizan-corridor.speaker: lantern
jizan-corridor.line: The trucks are in. Colonel, the node's log says it went quiet in 1953. I'll find out why.

jizan-corridor.speaker: badr
jizan-corridor.line: Pull back to the yard. We go again.

hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: nabil
hodeidah-lifeline.line: Supplies inland first. Keep the mobile force light and ready to move.

hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: lantern
hodeidah-lifeline.line: Captain, the sweep is coming. Get out of the marked zone early.

hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: nabil
hodeidah-lifeline.line: We're clear of the zone. Strange. The sweep turned before anything flew.

hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: lantern
hodeidah-lifeline.line: Every vehicle came back. Captain, that sweep moved four minutes early. Someone is reading the picture before it happens.

hodeidah-lifeline.speaker: nabil
hodeidah-lifeline.line: The road is closed. We'll open it again.

bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: turki
bab-al-mandab-passage.line: Four ships at first light. Radar and technology first, then we see what is hiding on the shore.

bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: lantern
bab-al-mandab-passage.line: Commander, the blind sectors aren't random. They follow one maintenance contract.

bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: turki
bab-al-mandab-passage.line: Launchers neutralised. The lanes are open.

bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: lantern
bab-al-mandab-passage.line: The ships are through. The contract belongs to the Obsidian Directorate, and its oldest file is a photograph from 1953 with one man cut out.

bab-al-mandab-passage.speaker: turki
bab-al-mandab-passage.line: Hold Passage Control. We try again at first light.

straits-shield.speaker: kemal
straits-shield.line: Recon above, armour ashore, ships along the crossing. Build all of it.

straits-shield.speaker: lantern
straits-shield.line: Colonel, the uplinks on the far shore don't answer to any country. They answer to the Directorate.

straits-shield.speaker: kemal
straits-shield.line: Three uplinks down. Now the relay.

straits-shield.speaker: kemal
straits-shield.line: The far shore is ours. Lantern, my engineers pulled a coil out of an uplink. It's older than my father, and it's still warm.

straits-shield.speaker: kemal
straits-shield.line: Fall back and rebuild. Repair and ships before we cross again.

haitan-network.speaker: lin
haitan-network.line: Restore the network first. Every link makes the next move possible.

haitan-network.speaker: lin
haitan-network.line: Command node online. Send the amphibious vehicles to the gate.

haitan-network.speaker: lantern
haitan-network.line: Commander, with their node down I can see where the traffic goes. One island. It isn't on any chart.

haitan-network.speaker: lin
haitan-network.line: The islands are online. Lantern, that island's signal carries a time code. Nineteen fifty-three.

haitan-network.speaker: lin
haitan-network.line: The network is down. Restore the node, then try the gate again.

hezbollah-relay.speaker: signals-chief
hezbollah-relay.line: Exercise begins. Economy first, then the workshop. Keep the signal alive.

hezbollah-relay.speaker: signals-chief
hezbollah-relay.line: The relay held. Turn the defence into an assault.

hezbollah-relay.speaker: signals-chief
hezbollah-relay.line: Exercise failed. Reset and go again.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: lantern
lights-in-the-water.line: Captain, a whole fishing fleet lost its navigation at once. Three crews are on the reef, and Orion patrols are out.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: nabil
lights-in-the-water.line: Lights off. Move in pairs. We bring everyone home.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: nabil
lights-in-the-water.line: First crew is safe. Two to go.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: nabil
lights-in-the-water.line: Second crew found by the jetty. The reef is next.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: tanya
lights-in-the-water.line: Took you long enough. Who is in charge here, and what year is it?

lights-in-the-water.speaker: lantern
lights-in-the-water.line: High tide. The transports can reach the landing now. Get everyone to the clinic.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: lantern
lights-in-the-water.line: The patrol boats are sweeping the reef in a grid. They're looking for someone in particular.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: tanya
lights-in-the-water.line: Name's Tanya. Last thing I remember, I had hold of a man's coat in 1953. Tell me you've seen him.

lights-in-the-water.speaker: nabil
lights-in-the-water.line: Pull back. We'll find them again.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.line: Twelve minutes. The ferries load, we hold. Nothing crosses that line but the ferries.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: lantern
hold-the-ferry-line.line: Orion Group is coming down all three roads.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.line: The ferries are loaded. Now get them across.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: orlov
hold-the-ferry-line.line: Colonel. You could have a much clearer picture of the strait. All you have to do is ask.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: tanya
hold-the-ferry-line.line: That voice. I chased it through a machine. That's Orlov.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.line: All four ferries are across. Now we hold until the town is clear of the strait.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.line: Every ferry crossed. Lantern, a prisoner had orders for a place called Glass Island.

hold-the-ferry-line.speaker: kemal
hold-the-ferry-line.line: The line broke. Spread out across all three roads.

glass-island.speaker: lin
glass-island.line: Three of us, one island, and every mast is watching. We move only when the circle goes dark.

glass-island.speaker: lantern
glass-island.line: Commander, the masts sweep on a cycle. Each one sleeps for a few seconds, then wakes. Watch the rings.

glass-island.speaker: tanya
glass-island.line: They've seen us. Keep moving, and don't give them a second look.

glass-island.speaker: orlov
glass-island.line: Commander Lin. You came all this way for a picture of my island. I would have sold you a clearer one.

glass-island.speaker: lantern
glass-island.line: First light in two minutes, Commander. The boat can't wait for the sun.

glass-island.speaker: lin
glass-island.line: One minute to first light. Get the specialist to the cove.

glass-island.speaker: lin
glass-island.line: Logs copied. There's something else in the vault: a film reel, labelled by hand. Nineteen fifty-three.

glass-island.speaker: lantern
glass-island.line: Your boat is in the north cove. The vault masts take turns; wait for the near one to sleep.

glass-island.speaker: einstein
glass-island.line: If you are hearing this, the echo has found you. It can be folded shut only once, the right way, from the place where it is anchored.

glass-island.speaker: lin
glass-island.line: The island saw us. Back to the beach, and we try again.

black-platform.speaker: turki
black-platform.line: Boarding team, quiet on the pad. The control room first: no charge will stick while that curtain is up.

black-platform.speaker: lantern
black-platform.line: Commander, the two deck scanners take turns. The lane down the middle is blind to both.

black-platform.speaker: tanya
black-platform.line: So much for quiet. Here comes the deck crew.

black-platform.speaker: lantern
black-platform.line: Orion's relief flotilla is two minutes out. Get those charges in before it reaches the platform.

black-platform.speaker: turki
black-platform.line: One minute until that flotilla is alongside. Every generator, now.

black-platform.speaker: turki
black-platform.line: The control room is ours and the curtain is down. Tanya, every generator.

black-platform.speaker: tanya
black-platform.line: Four for four. Somebody turn the lights back on.

black-platform.speaker: lantern
black-platform.line: Every screen on the coast just lit up at once. I can see the hub. Hold that room, Commander.

black-platform.speaker: orlov
black-platform.line: To every commander on this coast: I can still give you the picture you want. You have only to ask.

black-platform.speaker: lantern
black-platform.line: Nobody answered him. Not one channel. The hub is on every screen now.

black-platform.speaker: turki
black-platform.line: The team is down and the jamming holds. We board again.

every-light-on.speaker: badr
every-light-on.line: This is where the silence started. Radar domes first, then the machine.

every-light-on.speaker: lin
every-light-on.line: Colonel, Lin here. My network is feeding your radar relay. While it stands, you see everything.

every-light-on.speaker: turki
every-light-on.line: Platform holding, Colonel. Their jammers stay dark.

every-light-on.speaker: lantern
every-light-on.line: Gunboats coming down the northern lane, heading for your shore.

every-light-on.speaker: lantern
every-light-on.line: Your relay is down, Colonel. Lin's picture is gone; you're back in the fog.

every-light-on.speaker: orlov
every-light-on.line: Colonel. The radar that went quiet on your coast? I can make it remember a different morning. Name your price.

every-light-on.speaker: kemal
every-light-on.line: The northern lane is closed. No more boats come through, Colonel.

every-light-on.speaker: badr
every-light-on.line: Three domes down and the link is cut. Now we wait for Nabil.

every-light-on.speaker: nabil
every-light-on.line: The mainland towns are clear, every family out. The strike is yours, Colonel.

every-light-on.speaker: tanya
every-light-on.line: When that machine falls, he'll run for it. Let me be close when he does.

every-light-on.speaker: lantern
every-light-on.line: Running Einstein's sequence now. Once, the right way. Every light is coming back on.

every-light-on.speaker: tanya
every-light-on.line: He's out there somewhere in time. Somebody who knows his face should be waiting.

every-light-on.speaker: badr
every-light-on.line: Fall back to the yard. The machine is still running.

sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.line: Engineers stay with the camp. We open the road first, then we bring the water in.

sweet-water.speaker: lantern
sweet-water.line: Colonel, Lantern. The hub is dark, but its last cells are still moving. One of them is sitting on your town's water.

sweet-water.speaker: tanya
sweet-water.line: Tanya, at Lantern's desk. Whatever is under that plant, they want it more than the water. Don't let them leave with it.

sweet-water.speaker: lantern
sweet-water.line: Raiders coming down from the northern hills, heading for your camp.

sweet-water.speaker: lantern
sweet-water.line: The trucks are on their way, Colonel. The road has to be open when they reach the salt.

sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.line: The road is open. Bring the trucks through, and keep them moving.

sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.line: The trucks are at the cistern. The town drinks tonight. Now the plant.

sweet-water.speaker: orlov
sweet-water.line: Colonel Tavakoli. A town without water makes a sad picture. Leave me the plant's basement, and I will turn the taps back on myself.

sweet-water.speaker: lantern
sweet-water.line: The pumps are yours, and the cell's coils just went dark. There's a vault under the plant, Colonel. That's the cache.

sweet-water.speaker: tanya
sweet-water.line: Boats at the dock. They've come for the coils. Not one of them leaves this coast.

sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.line: The lock is cut. Engineer, take the vault. Gently.

sweet-water.speaker: tanya
sweet-water.line: Coils in a crate, dated 1953, wound by hand. Same as the one Kemal's engineers found. Somebody's been busy.

sweet-water.speaker: lantern
sweet-water.line: The taps are on and the cache is ours. Colonel, the crate's manifest lists one more, on another coast.

sweet-water.speaker: arash
sweet-water.line: Back to the road camp. The town still needs its water.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Nine contacts on the picture. Nobody fires on anything until we have seen it with our own eyes.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: lantern
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Colonel, Lantern. Six of those contacts weren't on any picture a minute ago. Send your observers first, and set everyone else to return fire.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: lantern
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Your column is closing on the contact in the school yard. Hold fire. That yard is the way into a shelter.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: lantern
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Nothing in the school yard but families going down to the shelter. That contact was never there.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Unverified contact by the north shelter. Nobody shoots it. Eyes first.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: lantern
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Nothing off the fishing quay. Empty water. Your picture is lying to you, Colonel.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: tanya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Ghost or not, somebody look at that one on the bridge road before you put a shell in it.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: That one is real, and it's shooting. Engage.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Boats on the beach north of the harbour. Real ones. Hold the line there.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: orlov
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: Colonel Ronen. Nine ships, and you have looked at so few. I can tell you which ones are real. It costs only your first shot.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: tanya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: In my day a radar full of ghosts meant somebody wanted you looking the wrong way. Find what's painting them.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: lantern
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: The relays are down. Every ghost just vanished. Whatever is still on your picture is real.

ghosts-on-the-glass.speaker: maya
ghosts-on-the-glass.line: There's the strike group the lie was covering. Hold the harbour.
